offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures respirators, gas detection instruments, fire helmets and protective gear sold to industrial employers and fire departments, delivered through direct sales and distributors worldwide.

primary_products.value: respirators; gas detectors; fire helmets; protective clothing; fall protection harnesses

primary_services.value: equipment calibration; repair; gas monitoring system installation

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial employers, mining, oil and gas, construction, utilities; B2G: fire departments, military and government agencies

end_markets.value: fire service; mining; oil and gas; construction; manufacturing; utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: respirators, gas detectors, helmets and protective gear sold to customers; service fees: calibration, repair and maintenance of gas detection and breathing equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes safety equipment from purchased components, sold to employers and fire departments; brand owner: designs and markets safety products sold through distributors and direct accounts

geography_served.value: global: Sells and manufactures in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: respiratory protection, gas detection, fire service helmets and apparel, fall protection
